lines.en: Mia, I failed the chemistry quiz. If I had revised more, I would have passed it easily.
lines.pt: Mia, fui mal no teste de química. Se eu tivesse revisado mais, teria passado com facilidade.

lines.en: Oh no, Dina. If you had asked me, I would have lent you my notes from the lectures.
lines.pt: Ah não, Dina. Se você tivesse me pedido, eu teria emprestado minhas anotações das aulas.

lines.en: I know, but I was too embarrassed. Honestly, I wish I had started earlier instead of watching series every night.
lines.pt: Eu sei, mas fiquei com vergonha. Sinceramente, queria ter começado mais cedo em vez de ver séries toda noite.

lines.en: Don’t be so hard on yourself. If I hadn’t talked to Professor Reed, I would have failed too.
lines.pt: Não seja tão dura consigo mesma. Se eu não tivesse conversado com o professor Reed, também teria reprovado.

lines.en: Did he explain the formulas again? I would have gone to his office hours if I had known.
lines.pt: Ele explicou as fórmulas de novo? Eu teria ido ao horário de atendimento dele se tivesse sabido.

lines.en: Yes, and he said the retake is next week, so you still have a chance to improve your grade.
lines.pt: Sim, e ele disse que a segunda chamada é semana que vem, então você ainda tem chance de melhorar sua nota.

lines.en: That is a relief. If I had missed that announcement, I would have lost the whole semester.
lines.pt: Que alívio. Se eu tivesse perdido esse aviso, teria perdido o semestre inteiro.

lines.en: Exactly. Let’s make a schedule today, so that we revise a little every evening until the retake.
lines.pt: Exato. Vamos fazer um cronograma hoje, para revisarmos um pouco toda noite até a segunda chamada.

lines.en: Good plan. If we had done this in October, we would have avoided all this stress.
lines.pt: Bom plano. Se tivéssemos feito isso em outubro, teríamos evitado todo esse estresse.

lines.en: True, but there is no point regretting it now. Bring your textbook to the classroom after lunch.
lines.pt: É verdade, mas não adianta se arrepender agora. Traga seu livro para a sala de aula depois do almoço.

lines.en: Deal. If I pass this time, I will buy you a coffee and a very big cake!
lines.pt: Combinado. Se eu passar desta vez, pago um café e um bolo bem grande para você!

facts.label: 3º condicional
facts.sub: If I had revised, I would have passed. If I hadn’t asked, I wouldn’t have known.

facts.label: If + had + particípio
facts.sub: Use if + past perfect na oração condicional e would have + particípio no resultado: If I had revised more, I would have passed. Em português: “se eu tivesse revisado, teria passado”. É irreal e se refere ao passado.

facts.label: hadn’t, wouldn’t have
facts.sub: Negativo: If I hadn’t talked to him, I would have failed. Resultado negativo: I wouldn’t have passed. Não use would na oração com if.

items.s: If I had revised, I would have passed is a third conditional.
We say “If I would have revised”.
items.why: We say If I had revised.

items.s: The if clause uses the past perfect.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: If I had revised, I would have passed is a third conditional. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “If I would have revised”. → Falso (We say If I had revised.)
The if clause uses the past perfect. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: After a difficult quiz · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold afternoon in Chicago. Esme leaves the chemistry classroom slowly. She holds a quiz with a red mark. Leo waits for her in the corridor. Other students talk about the results. Esme sighs and sits on a bench.

“Leo, I failed the chemistry quiz. If I had revised more, I would have passed it easily.” says Esme. “Oh no, Esme. If you had asked me, I would have lent you my notes from the lectures.” says Leo. “I know, but I was too embarrassed. Honestly, I wish I had started earlier instead of watching series every night.” says Esme.
